proposed_regimen.instructions: For verified fever or aches, use only while symptoms need relief. Space doses by at least 6 hours; limit to 3 doses (3000 mg) per 24 hours. Seek review for worsening fever or fever beyond 3 days, or worsening pain or pain beyond 10 days. This is not a fixed treatment course.

Shake the container before use; apply to affected skin only when itching needs relief. Keep away from eyes. Get clinician advice for worsening symptoms, symptoms persisting beyond 7 days, or recurring symptoms. External use; no fixed amount, daily frequency or course is specified by this label.
